name: Interactive Fixture
description: Contract fixture for the P25 interactive contributions: status item, language and MIME renderers, slash commands, mention and palette providers.

commands.title: Publish status item
commands.description: Publish a compact HUD status item through host.setStatusItem.

commands.title: Clear status item
commands.description: Hide the status item again, which releases the HUD slot.

commands.title: Render qa-card block
commands.description: Turn a closed qa-card fence into typed native blocks.

commands.title: Render PNG attachment
commands.description: Turn a sent image attachment into a typed native card.

commands.title: Query mention items
commands.description: Return insertable items for an @ reference.

commands.title: Query palette items
commands.description: Return palette results whose commands are declared here.

slashCommands.title: QA status
slashCommands.name: qa-status
slashCommands.description: Run the fixture status command from the composer.

slashCommands.title: QA prompt
slashCommands.name: qa-prompt
slashCommands.description: Insert a prompt template the user completes before sending.
